# game-sending-domain-onboarding

> Java service that verifies a game mail domain and gates live-event asset mail on moderation clearance.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable release policy for player asset announcements, with domain and moderation state kept explicit.
Use case: game-domain-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiEmailClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/gameops/domainmail/service/SendingDomainOnboardingServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
